longTitle.officialTitle:
To direct the Secretary of Health and Human Services to carry out a national project to prevent, diagnose, treat, and cure Parkinson’s, to be known as the National Parkinson’s Project, and for other purposes.
July 2, 2024
[H.R. 2365]

enactingFormula.i: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representa­tives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

sidenote.p: Dr. Emmanuel Bilirakis and Honorable Jennifer Wexton National Plan to End Parkinson’s Act.

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Dr. Emmanuel Bilirakis and Honorable Jennifer Wexton National Plan to End Parkinson’s Act”.

section.heading: NATIONAL PARKINSON’S PROJECT.
